(as ''Balzan Youths'') | ground = | chrtitle = President | chairman = Anton Tagliaferro | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Andrew Cohen (footballer)|Andrew Cohen]] | league = [[Maltese Premier League]] | season = [[2025–26 Maltese Challenge League|2025–26]] | position = [[Maltese Challenge League]], 1st of 12 (promoted) | website = {{URL|https://balzanfc1937.com/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _jomapisa2rw | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FF0000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = FF0000 | shorts1 = FF0000 | socks1 = FF0000 | pattern_la2 = _jomagold5bg | pattern_b2 = _jomagold5bg | pattern_ra2 = _jomagold5bg | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 }} '''Balzan Football Club''' is a Maltese professional [[Association football|football]] club from the village of [[Balzan]] that competes in the [[Maltese Premier League]], the top tier of Maltese football. The club was founded as ''Balzan Youths'' in 1937 and played in the top division between 2010 and 2025. They were renamed ''Balzan FC'' in June 2012.{{cite web|url=https://balzanfc1937.com/club-history/|title=Club History|website=Balzan FC|access-date=20 April 2024}} Balzan has qualified for the [[UEFA Europa League]] for five consecutive seasons (2015–16 to 2019–20). The club finished as runners-up in the [[Maltese Premier League]] in the 2016–17 and 2017–18 seasons and were finalists of the [[2015–16 Maltese FA Trophy]], which they lost on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]] to [[Sliema Wanderers F.C.|Sliema Wanderers]] after a goalless draw in the regular time. In May 2019, the club finally won its first major honour, the [[2018–19 Maltese FA Trophy]], after defeating [[Valletta F.C.|Valletta]] on penalties in the final.{{cite news |last= Camilleri|first= Valhmor|date=18 May 2019|title= Effiong scores four as Balzan win first-ever FA Trophy|url= https://www.timesofmalta.com/articles/view/20190518/football/balzan-edge-valletta-in-shoot-out-to-win-fa-trophy.710351|work= Times of Malta |access-date= 19 May 2019}}"}}
